name: Length limits for short video, as each app publishes them

platforms.name: YouTube Shorts
platforms.rule: Square or vertical uploads up to 3 minutes are Shorts: from October 15, 2024 on most channels, from December 8, 2025 on Official Artist Channels

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.rule: Up to 60 minutes uploaded in the phone app and 30 minutes uploaded on the web in TikTok Studio, 10 minutes recorded in the app; through the Content Posting API, 10 minutes from the Upload endpoint, and each account's own maximum (max_video_post_duration_sec) for Direct Post; non-Spark In-Feed ads run up to 10 minutes

sources.title: TikTok Studio (Upload on a web browser)
Content Posting API: Media Transfer Guide (Duration restrictions)
Content Posting API: query creator info (max_video_post_duration_sec)

platforms.name: Instagram Reels
platforms.rule: Up to 20 minutes recorded and edited in the app (Instagram Help gives no separate figure for uploading a file), and reels over 3 minutes are not recommended to new audiences; through the publishing API, 3 seconds to 15 minutes

sources.title: Instagram Platform: IG User Media reference (Reel specifications)

platforms.name: Facebook Reels
platforms.rule: No length limit for reels posted on Facebook (Meta, June 2025); the Page Reels publishing API takes 3 to 90 seconds

sources.title: Making it easier to create videos on Facebook (June 17, 2025): reels have no length or format restrictions
